channel.title: Made in Minnesota - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Made in Minnesota (minnesotasnewcountry.com)

item.title: Navigating Four-way Stops In St. Cloud: A Familiar Dance Of Patience, Confusion &amp; Distraction
item.description: St. Cloud drivers are facing daily frustrations at four-way stops, where cars often sit in confusion, with distracted driving making the wait even longer at traffic signals.

item.title: Fast-paced Panel Discussion With 4 Mystery Authors At Great River Libraries This Week
item.description: Mystery fans are in for a treat at the Great River Regional Library, where acclaimed authors reveal their writing secrets and engage in lively discussions through all week long through Saturday!

item.title: $2.5 Million Grant Boosts Highway 15 Improvements In St. Cloud
item.description: St. Cloud's Highway 15 is getting a $2.5 million boost for improvements, focusing on safer, faster travel with new median U-turn intersections and thorough planning for a better commute.

item.title: Authorities Give Update on Investigation into Fire That Took The Lives of Jessi Pierce, Her Children &amp; Their Dog
item.description: A devastating fire in White Bear Lake took the lives of sports personality Jessi Pierce, her three children, and their dog, leaving the community in mourning and supporting her husband, Mike.

item.title: Chevy Express Van Collides With Parked Box Truck in Eden Lake Township
item.description: A morning crash in Eden Lake Township pinned a driver inside his van after colliding with a parked box truck, but thankfully he only suffered minor injuries.

item.title: New YouTube Series Promises Sourdough Success For Beginners
item.description: Backwards Bread Company in St. Cloud is sharing their baking passion with a new YouTube channel.

item.title: St. Cloud Schools See Graduation Rates Rise For Class Of 2025
item.description: St. Cloud's Class of 2025 sees graduation rates rise, with Tech High hitting 85.3%. Community efforts are praised, but data discrepancies remind us there's more work to do.

item.title: Two-vehicle Collision on Highway 10 Leaves One Critically Injured
item.description: In the early hours on Highway 10, a deer caused a crash that critically injured one driver and put another in the hospital.

item.title: Limited-edition Oreos: Gimmicky Fun Colors but are the Flavors Good?
item.description: In a playful twist, Oreo's new Marvel cookies turn tongues blue or green

item.title: Could Marijuana Prices In Minnesota Finally Go Down?
item.description: Only 20% of the available cultivation canopy is being used in the state. That may change by the end of 2026.

item.title: Support Veterans And Enjoy Hot Air Balloons At Freedom Flight Auction
item.description: Freedom Flight is kicking off an online auction April 8, featuring 100 unique items to fund hot air balloon operations and honor veterans, including the poignant POW MIA balloon.

item.title: A Split-Second Choice Took Three Minnesota Lives
item.description: Real Minnesota families are sharing devastating stories tied to distracted driving. A reminder that one choice can change everything.

item.title: St. Johns Hockey Finishes Strong With A MIAC Title And 15th Rank In Final DIII Poll
item.description: The St. Johns hockey team finished strong, ranking 15th in the final DIII poll after capturing the MIAC title and making a solid NCAA tournament run this season.

item.title: New Winter Storm Warnings Now Issued In Over 50 Minnesota Cities
St. Cloud’s Devon Bowker and Paige Janorschke Are 2026 Teacher of the Year Finalists
item.description: Two St. Cloud educators, Devon Bowker and Paige Janorschke, are finalists for the 2026 Minnesota Teacher of the Year award, showcasing their commitment to inspiring students in local schools.
